text:
maya: Quick sync 1: MerchantX testimonial + short interview to feed May 12 launch assets. Looking for a 150s quoted soundbite and a 125m interview clip we can use in the webinar promo. Can we record next week?

sam: Week looks clear. Prefer morning slot. Do we need quote locked before recording?

lina: We need a signed release before publish and quote approval before social. Post proposed quote here and I'll do a quick review.

kevin: Routing: webinar signups from this asset should map to SFDC campaign "Merchant Webinar May" and go to the "Mid-Market Merchants" SDR queue. Maya, can you add UTM params so we can split source by channel?

maya: Draft quote: "Redwood cut our inference costs by nearly 3x, which let us ship features faster and scale predictably."

sam: Love it. For social captions maybe: "~3x lower inference costs + faster ship."

lina: Hold on the "3x" language until Research confirms; legal prefers documented backing when using figures. If Research uploads the benchmark and methodology, we can keep the figure with a link.

maya: @noah can you confirm the benchmark and drop the spreadsheet? If not, I can change to "significantly lower".

publish-bot: Created intake ticket asset-9213. Required steps: book recording, signed release, quote approval, embed benchmark link, set UTM + SFDC mapping.

noah: I ran MerchantX workload tests last month. Median cost improvement is ~2.8x. Fine to say "~3x" if we attach the benchmark doc and a short methodology note. I'll upload the CSV + README to Drive and paste link here by EOD.

lina: Good. With Research doc we can approve the "~3x" phrasing. I'll draft a release template and a brief methodology blurb we can paste on the landing page. Please make sure the landing page shows the parenthetical link to the benchmark.

kevin: Also recommend a CTA variation that routes paid traffic to a demo request and organic to webinar signup. I'll coordinate with Ops to ensure forms have hidden fields for campaign and UTM.

maya: Proposed recording slot: Wed 5/5 10:30am PT. 20-minute block (10m prebrief, 10m recording). Who needs calendar invites?

sam: I'll be on the call to ask product questions.

kevin: SDR lead present for handoff post-publish.

lina: I'll review the release draft if the quote + benchmark link are posted by EOD Monday.

maya: Perfect. I'll lock the calendar, attach pre-interview questions, share the release draft, and include the UTM spec. Will tag Ops for SFDC mapping. Thanks everyone :tada:
